title: Warmly Wrapped Vietnamese Chicken Wings Com Tam
description: Funky and tender Vietnamese dish featuring chicken wings, served with com tam, a popular Vietnamese street food, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly version is a twist on the classic.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken wings in a single layer.
Bake the chicken wings for 25 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the com tam according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped scallions and fried shallots.
Once the chicken is done, wrap each wing in a piece of com tam and top with shredded mozzarella cheese and the scallion-shallot mixture.
Return the wrapped chicken wings to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
